# Example: two doses and a secondary endpoint

- **Scenario:** [`example_k3`](../../scenarios/example_k3.R)
- **Author:** graphicalmcp-bench maintainers
- **Date:** 2026-11-16
- **Run:** 2026-11-16, commit `b0e3c85`, R 4.5.2, graphicalMCP 0.2.9

H1 and H2 test the high and low dose against a shared control, so their statistics are correlated (rho = 0.5). H3 is a secondary endpoint of the high dose: it gets no initial alpha and can only receive alpha from H1, so the low dose (H2) passes everything it frees to H1.

## Setup

- 3 hypotheses, one-sided alpha = 0.025, weighted Bonferroni tests
- Grid: w_step = 0.05, g_step = 0.1, 2,541 candidate graphs
- Search: 10,000 simulations (seed 2024), search time 2 s
- Re-evaluation: 100,000 independent simulations (seed 2025), standard errors from 20 batch means

**Marginal power**

|  | H1 | H2 | H3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Power | 0.9 | 0.8 | 0.7 |

**Correlation of the test statistics**

|  | H1 | H2 | H3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | 1 | 0.5 | 0 |
| H2 | 0.5 | 1 | 0 |
| H3 | 0 | 0 | 1 |

**Constraints**

Weights (free = searched):

|  | H1 | H2 | H3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Weight | free | free | 0 |

Transitions (free = searched):

| from \ to | H1 | H2 | H3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | – | free | free |
| H2 | free | – | 0 |
| H3 | free | free | – |

**Metrics** (maximized; `R` is the simulations x hypotheses rejection matrix)

| Metric | Definition |
|---|---|
| `er` | `sum(R)/nrow(R)` |
| `dp` | `mean(rowSums(R) > 0)` |
| `cp` | `mean(rowSums(R) == ncol(R))` |
| `h1h3` | `mean(R[, "H1"] & R[, "H3"])` |

## Optimal graphs

Values are re-evaluated on independent simulations (estimate ± Monte-Carlo standard error). The search values used for the ranking are optimistic for the winners.

### Trade-off

Each row is the graph that is optimal for one metric, evaluated on every metric.

| Optimal for | `er` | `dp` | `cp` | `h1h3` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `er` | **2.2336 ± 0.0040** | 0.9101 ± 0.0011 | 0.5181 ± 0.0017 | 0.5911 ± 0.0018 |
| `dp` | 2.2327 ± 0.0041 | **0.9115 ± 0.0012** | 0.5178 ± 0.0017 | 0.5887 ± 0.0018 |
| `cp` | 2.0795 ± 0.0047 | 0.8015 ± 0.0016 | **0.5263 ± 0.0017** | 0.5263 ± 0.0017 |
| `h1h3` | 2.0549 ± 0.0041 | 0.8992 ± 0.0012 | 0.5263 ± 0.0017 | **0.6295 ± 0.0018** |
